recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless a future generated fhir-base.xsd reintroduces the obsolete misspelling.
issue_request: FHIR-3531 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction asking to rename the misspelled fhir-base.xsd schema names QuantityCompararator and QuantityCompararator-list to QuantityComparator and QuantityComparator-list.
initial_application: The Jira comments record application as SVN revision 3531. In the git-svn history, commit 2eb184975748637395337dcc8dfda45a4a6eff7d corrected QuantityCompararator to QuantityComparator in source/bindings.ini, source/datatypes/quantity.xml, and the then-current source/profile/profile-example.xml.
additional_context: fhir-base.xsd is generated rather than checked in as current source. The current source inputs use QuantityComparator, source/history.html only quotes the old typo in a release note, and build.fhir.org/fhir-base.xsd exposes QuantityComparator/QuantityComparatorEnum. Community searches found no conflicting FHIR-core decision; one Zulip hit was an unrelated HAPI implementation thread about a deprecated external enum.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because the current build inputs and generated schema already satisfy the Jira request.
